items.title: Vulnerabilities in LMS software
items.summary: CERT Polska has received a report about 3 vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-127142, CVE-2026-127143 and CVE-2026-129961) found in LMS software.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in CAST Imaging software
items.summary: CERT Polska has received a report about 8 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-109857 to CVE-2026-109864) found in CAST Software Imaging.

items.title: Vulnerability in Axence nVision software
items.summary: Use of HTTP Request With Sensitive Query String vulnerability (CVE-2026-87850) has been found in Axence nVision software.

items.title: Vulnerability in Bludit software
items.summary: Path Traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-107190) has been found in Bludit software.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in VisualNet visualTicket software
items.summary: CERT Polska has received a report about 14 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-113443 to CVE-2026-113456) found in VisualNet visualTicket software.

items.title: Vulnerability in Batflat software
items.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability (CVE-2026-111559) has been found in Batflat software.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in Edito CMS software
items.summary: CERT Polska has received a report about 8 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-59074 to CVE-2026-59081) found in Edito CMS software.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in WidzialniCMS software
items.summary: CERT Polska coordinated disclosure of 4 vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-110468, CVE-2026-110469, CVE-2026-112204 and CVE-2026-112205) found in WidzialniCMS software.

items.title: Vulnerability in KAMSOFT ZSIRep CLIENT library
items.summary: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability (CVE-2026-113618) has been found in KAMSOFT ZSIRep CLIENT library.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in Request Tracker and RT for Incident Response software
items.summary: During its own research, CERT Polska has found 3 XSS vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-105454 to CVE-2026-105456) in Request Tracker (RT) and RT for Incident Response software (RTIR).
